name: rsi_dip_buyer
idea: Buy liquid stocks that are oversold on RSI while still in a long-term uptrend, and sell once RSI recovers.
description: Long-only mean reversion: enter when RSI drops below an oversold threshold while price is above its long moving average; exit when RSI recovers.
hypothesis: Short-lived liquidity shocks push healthy stocks below fair value; providing liquidity to forced sellers earns the rebound.

universe.name: all
universe.description: Every stock in the warehouse with at least $5m/day traded

params.name: oversold
params.description: RSI level below which a stock is bought

params.name: recovered
params.description: RSI level above which the position is closed

params.name: trend_window
params.description: Moving-average length defining the long-term uptrend

params.name: position_cap
params.description: Maximum weight of any one position

rules.entry_long: rsi(close, rsi_window) < oversold and close > ts_mean(close, trend_window)

assumptions: Uninvested capital sits in cash earning nothing
